about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Service you can rely on — clear pricing, tidy work, and warranty.
about.section1Body: We install and service air conditioners and split systems for apartments, offices, and commercial spaces. We focus on consistent quality and predictable results.
about.section2Body: We start with diagnostics, recommend the right solution, and explain what will be done and why. We work neatly and follow safety standards.
about.section3Body: We use professional tools and consumables. Warranty terms depend on the type of work and are agreed in advance.
about.fact1Desc: In many areas a technician can arrive within 2 hours.
about.fact2Desc: We explain the scope of work and provide clear recommendations.
about.fact3Desc: Warranty for work and parts according to agreement.
